Messages.Body:
Peter Jack <peter.jack@onlinesys.com> wrote:
>  Last night my opponent had one of his minions (with superior dominate)
>try to take a political action at +1 stealth. I managed to block it. He
>played Bonding, which, for superior Dominate, reads "+1 bleed and +1
>stealth". He claimed that the +1 stealth of Bonding could be applied to
>his political action.

Your opponent was incorrect.  Action modifiers which carry a bleed modifier
may only be played during bleed type actions (including Social Charm, etc)
and can't be used on any old action you feel like.
